Reduction modulo two of every 7x7 cofactor has rank 4, proving 8-divisibility. The support indicator has exact transformed absolute sum 56972, independently checked by direct sums on all orbit representatives. Translation averaging proves the evaluated norm 14243/1024 minimizes over all projections onto the range.

value.rationale: Q3 is the canonical first three-dimensional cube, with a classical 384-element spanning-tree family and twelve independent edge-sign coordinates. The exact nonzero Fourier support identifies the recoverable subspace of a natural convolution operator, while the minimum endpoint range-projection norm quantifies sharp worst-case deconvolution stability and is not implied by counting trees. The complete finite classification and rigorous norm calculation are motivated natural invariants, not arbitrary parameter slices or routine small improvements.
